text: 中国人民银行、国家金融监督管理总局印发《关于改革完善房地产信贷管理推动加快构建房地产发展新模式的意见》的通知。通知提出，银行业金融机构不得发放用于缴交土地出让价款及相关税费的贷款。银行业金融机构可以在房地产开发建设阶段发放房地产开发贷款，包括商品住房开发贷款、保障性住房开发贷款、住房租赁开发建设贷款、商业地产开发贷款等。银行业金融机构应加强房地产开发贷款封闭管理，确保专款专用，实现贷款发放与项目建设周期相匹配。银行业金融机构可以在房地产销售阶段发放购房贷款，包括个人住房贷款、住房租赁团体购房贷款、商业用房购房贷款等。银行业金融机构应严格执行个人住房贷款发
text_en: The People's Bank of China and the National Financial Regulatory Administration issued the Notice on the Opinions on Reforming and Improving Real Estate Credit Management to Accelerate the Establishment of a New Model for Real Estate Development. The notice states that banking financial institutions should not issue loans for paying land transfer fees and related taxes. Banking financial institutions can issue real estate development loans during the development and construction stage, including commercial housing development loans, affordable housing development loans, rental housing development and construction loans, and commercial real estate development loans. Banking financial institutions should strengthen closed management of real estate development loans, ensure earmarked use, and align loan disbursement with the project construction cycle. Banking financial institutions can issue home purchase loans during the real estate sales stage, including personal housing loans, rental housing group purchase loans, and commercial property purchase loans. Banking financial institutions should strictly implement the issuance of personal housing loans.
